profile.title: Profile & KYC
profile.description: Your agency details and verification documents.
profile.welcomeBody: Complete your agency details and upload your registration certificate and ID proof, then submit for review. You can add patients and send enquiries while we verify your agency.

kyc.submitted: KYC submitted for review. We will notify you once it is reviewed.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Updates on your patients’ cases, quotes, bookings and commission.

referral.title: Referral
referral.shareMessage: Explore world-class treatment in India with Heal India Global. Start here: {{url}}
referral.description: Patients who sign up with your link or code are linked to your agency, so their bookings count towards your commission.
referral.codeHint: Patients can enter this code when registering on the Heal India Global app or website.

referral.howBody: When a referred or managed patient completes a treatment booked through the platform, your commission is calculated on the hospital amount and appears under Commissions. It becomes eligible after the holding period and is paid to your verified payout account on the next settlement cycle.

cases.title: Cases & quotes
cases.description: Every enquiry is a case with one hospital. Tick two or three cases to compare their quotes side by side.
cases.compareMax: Compare up to {{max}} cases at a time
cases.emptyDescription: Send an enquiry to hospitals on behalf of a patient. You can contact up to three hospitals at once.

caseDetail.bookingCancelled: Booking cancelled. Any refund due under the cancellation policy will be processed automatically.
caseDetail.noQuoteYet: The hospital has not sent a quote yet. You will be notified when it arrives.
caseDetail.documentsHint: Shared with the hospital on this case
caseDetail.cancelCaseDescription: The hospital is notified and stops working on this enquiry.

gate.emergency: This case was screened as a possible emergency. Review and acknowledge the emergency guidance first.
gate.guest: The patient is on a guest account and must create a full account before quotes can be accepted or booked.

quotes.accepted: Quote accepted — you can now book the treatment
quotes.acceptBody: The hospital is notified and the case moves to <0>accepted</0>. Next you choose the admission date and payment option to create the booking.
quotes.declineDescription: The hospital can send a revised quote.
quotes.declinePlaceholder: e.g. Budget too high, prefer shorter stay

bookCase.title: Book treatment

bookCase.payInstallments: Pay a deposit now and the balance in monthly instalments.
bookCase.insuranceHint: The hospital prepares the documents required for the claim.

bookings.title: Bookings
